description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Creating and uploading KeyPackages. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L826.

Text: "If a recipient obtains the KeyPackage, it MUST verify
that the two values match."

Problem: The draft defines no action when KeyPackageInfo.cipher_suite and the KeyPackage's ciphersuite differ. Implementations will diverge on whether to process Welcomes to that KeyPackage.

Suggested fix: Specify the action on mismatch, for example: discard the material for that KeyPackageRef and do not process Welcomes addressed to it.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (Confirmed at L826-827: a MUST-verify with no action defined on mismatch.)
